observations.observation: CustomerProfile excludes password/role, redacts toString; CustomerTarget contains only ID/role/status/original time and never enters a view.
CustomerMapper has explicit safe SELECT columns and no BaseMapper select-star entry point; existing login authentication is unchanged.
Count/list share CUSTOMER plus bound literal username/status filter; no request text enters ORDER BY.
Explicit ESCAPE ! with literal !/%/_ handling and ordinary bound backslash; actual MyBatis annotation and parameter resolution privately observed.
Long page values clamp minimum1; impossible offset short-circuited; exact offset()/likePattern() record accessors exist.
Read detail only SELECTs role=CUSTOMER, unknown/ADMIN404 and invalid pathID400.
Status RC transaction first database operation is AdminWriteGuard.lock(actor), before target ID parsing/lookup.
Target is safely projected by ID FOR UPDATE, then checked CUSTOMER; no target loaded before administrator lock.
Resource404 precedes targetStatus validation; valid resource requires exactly one enum value, otherwise400.
Status action ignores extra role/password/profile inputs; only targetStatus is read for updates.
Same current status returns before all DML, retaining exact original updated_at.
Conditional UPDATE restricts id/role/current status/original microsecond stamp, writes onlystatus and explicit GREATEST(now6,stamp+1micro), checks affected1.
DataIntegrityViolation/Concurrency failure becomes safe409 and rolls back, with no automatic write retry.
New status code has no cart/product/order/item mapper, never cancels orders or restocks.
Fixed flash messages and303 canonical positive-ID destination;400/409 local recovery view contains only safe fields.
Single SELECT has five independent COUNT subqueries, excludes ADMIN customer counts and includes sold-out ON_SALE product rows.
Query exceptions produce dedicated500 fixed retry view with no count model or technical message; null result also fails instead of fallback0.
Only new DashboardController owns GET/; old HomeController explicitly removed; Category classes remain.
No user module, SQL/POM/Wrapper/dependency change, real logistics, customer account editing, password/role action, REST, concurrency or production fault hook introduced.
